rationale: Round 2 has sharpened positions into a stable impasse: employee and state actors hold firm against closures and forced redundancies, while management, owners, and investors insist on structurally equivalent footprint reduction and have not yet produced a mutually acceptable quantified bridge. The discussion is now circling around process and burden-sharing rhetoric without substantive movement on the core contested trade-offs, so facilitation around numbers/options is needed before another round.
